note: Both sets invent airfoil names not present in the legends (A: FFA-W3-2/-3/-5/-1; B: FFA-W3-210/-3/-1/-4) and both misbind several values to a truncated "SNL-FFA" entity. Set A recovers more defensible readings from the curves (SNL-FFA-W3-500 Cl at -20 deg, max Cl/Cd ≈ 20, FFA-W3-211 max Cl/Cd ≈ 120, Cl ≈ 1.8 at 20 deg for 241/270blend, plausible Cd at Cl = 1.5), whereas Set B repeats a systematic misreading of Cl = 0.0 at angle of attack 0 deg four times and garbles the SNL legend name. Set A still has clearly wrong values (Cl/Cd = 100 at 10 deg, Cd = 0.04 at Cl = 1.5, min Cd = 0.01, max Cl/Cd = 115), but it is somewhat more faithful overall.
